description: 函数指针表：13 槽 u32。槽 0 与槽 12 是 FFFFFFFF 哨兵，槽 1..11 是 11 个代码指针（0x08061C8D 起每槽 +12 字节等距）。真实基址 0x53D5F0（原生读者 0x08061DD4，fn 0x08061D8C）。

fields.name: slot_value
fields.description: 槽内容：FFFFFFFF = 哨兵，否则是代码指针（业务名未定）

notes: Function pointer table with 11 entries. All entries point to Thumb code (PUSH instructions starting with 0xB5). The functions are located in the 0x061C8D-0x061D05 region and appear to be small functions that call a common function with different parameters (R0 = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, etc.). Located in the 0x53Dxxx region near the map headers. The functions appear to be menu or UI related based on their structure. 2026-10-22 合并：逆向侧把该表框定为 13 槽（槽 0 与槽 12 是 0xFFFFFFFF 哨兵，槽 1..11 是代码指针），本 bank 采用该框定；此前只存 11 个指针（从 0x53D5F4 起），是同一张表的子集。
verification_method: 0x08061D8C indexes callback_id*4 from sentinel base 0x0853D5F0; 0x08061DD4..0x08061DDC loads the selected pointer and stores it into a 0x4C-byte task record. A natural cold-load profile route hit callback ID 2 twice at entry 0x0853D5F8 with pointer 0x08061C99. Replacing only that slot with adjacent wrapper 3 caused an early, visible profile-task divergence. Entries 1..11 are wrappers at 0x08061C8C..0x08061D0E that pass the matching one-based ID to common function 0x08061C58.
discovered_by: Examining region 0x53D000-0x53E000 between story tables and map headers
